Pin.Rule: minimize worst paired signed-vector excess over common independently association-valid regimes; ties fewer iterations
Pin.Qualification: conditional one-sided CP lower95 >= .95 for association and jointly trusted association on selection; repeat on validation
Pin.SimultaneousBound: 10000 centred whole-seed cluster bootstrap resamples after dividing each signed vector by its fixed geometric target; radius = .95 higher quantile of maximum normalized mean-vector deviation across pinned regimes; condition UCL=observed norm+radius*target
Pin.CoverageLimitation: bootstrap approximation; not a detector accuracy or a new gate guarantee
Pin.CalibrationKnowledge: independent transported background map, 500000 incident histories per head/seed; no generating Ambient access

SensitivityScope.WrongShape: front-only on bare truth, diagnostic only; public metadata refuses
